decisions.reason: Cleaning soap is a low-risk, recurring accessory that supports the installed base and strengthens the firm's full floor-care system offering.
Maintenance oil remains closely tied to the core wood-floor business and offers attractive after-sales revenue with limited strategic downside.
The care product for oiled floors fits the lifecycle proposition well, though some overlap with other maintenance items makes it slightly more exposed to later range simplification.
A moisture-protection underlay is a practical installation complement for trade customers and fits naturally into a system-sales approach.
High-density underlay foam extends the installation package around the firm's flooring products and is likely worth retaining in a growing business.
The oak parquet line is highly aligned with the firm's core manufacturing know-how, brand positioning, and innovation focus, making withdrawal unlikely.
